question: Should Birdclaw permanently make archive imports merge-safe by default, with explicit `--restore` required for exact replacement of imported slices?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes the user-facing meaning of repeated archive imports and introduces a long-lived schema-v6 retention contract; correctness tests do not determine which default existing users should receive.

options.title: Adopt merge-safe imports
options.body: Accept the non-destructive default and retain explicit `--restore` as the supported path for deliberate exact replacement.

options.title: Preserve replacement semantics
options.body: Request a revision that keeps the prior replacement-style archive behavior as the default and exposes merge preservation as an explicit opt-in.

options.title: Pause for migration review
options.body: Hold the PR until the owner completes a focused upgrade review against existing v0.11 databases and schema-v1–v5 backups.

recommendation.title: Adopt merge-safe imports
recommendation.body: Accept the non-destructive default and retain explicit `--restore` as the supported path for deliberate exact replacement.
